answer.generated: In distributed database systems, it is impossible to distinguish between node failure and network partition because both situations cause communication failures between nodes. The system can detect that a failure has occurred, but without additional information, it cannot determine whether the issue stems from a node crashing or from a network outage. This ambiguity complicates fault-tolerance mechanisms, as recovery strategies must handle both cases similarly while also dealing with the challenge of identifying which nodes are actually still operational.
